# Permissions

<!-- Generated by `make generate-permissions`. Do not edit. -->

Each Permission is a procedure the user may call. `GetMe` lists
the signed-in user's Permissions; hide any action whose Permission is
missing, because the server refuses it.

A Role grants the Permissions ticked in its column. A user with a Scope
keeps only the Permissions ticked under "With a Scope"; the rest reach
past any Scope, so only whole-tenant users get them.

The live query endpoint is not a procedure, so it has no Permission:
every member may open it.
